title: The Kamogawa Food Detectives by Hishashi Kashiwai
description:
Novels and Nibbles is tracking down food characters in this novel have been dreaming about for 30 years with a father and daughter running a tucked-away Kyoto diner. Together, they follow the faintest clues hidden in their customers’ memories like the crackle of a frying pan, the sweetness of a sauce, the warmth of a meal to recreate dishes from their past that time has nearly erased. A loved one’s cooking or a long-lost favorite becomes the starting point for stories full of longing, affection, and delicious discoveries. It’s a cozy, quietly emotional read that may leave you missing someone, craving Japanese food and/or wondering which meal you would love to taste one more time.

Inspired by Nobuko Nadaya’s Lost Beef Stew, we’re serving a little nostalgia by the spoonful. Tender beef is slow cooked in rich roasted beef gravy with baby carrots, bay red potatoes, onion, garlic, celery tomato, and green peas. Rosemary and thyme (from our herb garden) and a splash of red wine bring warmth and depth, while parsley adds that finishing touch. Served with garlic bread for soaking up every savory drop because gravy this good deserves a clean bowl. Make it a cozy occasion by pairing it with a glass of our Oko Organic Pinot Noir. YUM.

You’re going to fall spoon over heels for this Beef Stew. Coming in for a taste is a must.
